topPRs.title: eth/069-070: bump Unichain Chain Governor nonce pins after its 069 approval
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
## Why

The Unichain Chain Governor Safe [`0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC`](https://etherscan.io/address/0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC) **approved task 069 on-chain** in [`0xdc5de66b…4ecd1`](https://etherscan.io/tx/0xdc5de66b3683a3b09ed58adc26e66f2a91351ea42c7fec8edea8b98e7224ecd1) (block 25956808), taking its nonce from `19` to `20`. The state-override pins in 069/070 still assumed `19`/`20`, so `StateOverrideManager` rejected 069's pin and `stacked_simulation_eth` has failed on `main` since job [210418](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/210418) (latest: [210469](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/210469)).

Verified live: `cast call 0xb0c4…44EC "nonce()(uint256)"` returns `20`, and `approvedHashes[chain-governor][0x853896d5…4390]` on the 3-of-3 [`0x6d5B…5833`](https://etherscan.io/address/0x6d5B183F538ABB8572F5cD17109c617b994D5833) is `1`.

## What

| Task | CG pin | CG message hash |
|---|---|---|
| 069 | `19` → `20` | `0x28e77c5d…6197` → `0x3cbf706c1d884418b1747e65b9d5f4fc0cf22f4591ad9f47517b2df845259c85` |
| 070 | `20` → `21` | `0xe2d1b1a2…e6ed` → `0x3f3046779ff8be4fcb83c0e82311351d2cec5ae0d71877f9987629133748fdb6` |

Also updated the CG nonce before/after lines in both `VALIDATION.md` files, and added a note to 069 recording that the CG's approval is already on-chain.

**The root safe transaction hashes are unchanged** (069 `0x853896d5…4390`, 070 `0x586752c3…f2af`), so:
- The Foundation Upgrade Safe and Security Council domain/message hashes are untouched — no re-signing needed, and any signatures already collected stay valid.
- The Chain Governor's existing on-chain approval of 069 stays valid. Its hashes here only apply if it signs again.

069 is **not** executed on mainnet (1 of 3 child approvals in), so no `Status:` change — see [thread](https://optimism.slack.com/archives/C03N11M0BBN/p1789233150447599).

## Verification

- `just simulate-stack eth` (the failing CI job) passes.
- `just simulate-stack eth 069-… chain-governor` and `… 070-… chain-governor` pass, printing exactly the two hashes above.
- Both new hashes were also derived independently, by rebuilding the CG's `aggregate3Value(approveHash(rootHash))` SafeTx from the on-chain approval calldata: that reconstruction reproduces the *old* hashes byte-for-byte at nonce `19`/`20`, and yields the new ones at `20`/`21`.

Prompted by: maurelian

topPRs.title: fix(eth): bump Unichain Chain Governor Safe nonce pin in tasks 069/070
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
Fixes the failing scheduled `stacked_simulation_eth` job on `main`: https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/210596

## Root cause

The Unichain Chain Governor Safe [`0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC`](https://etherscan.io/address/0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC) advanced to nonce `20` on-chain after tasks 069/070 were authored, while `069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers/config.toml` still pinned `19`:

```
Error: script failed: StateOverrideManager: User-defined nonce (19) is less than current actual nonce (20) for contract: 0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC in task config file: src/tasks/eth/069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers/config.toml
```

## Changes

| Task | Safe | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| `eth/069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers` | Unichain Chain Governor | `19` | `20` (live on-chain value) |
| `eth/070-unichain-l2pao-transfer` | Unichain Chain Governor | `20` | `21` (one ahead, 069 signs first) |

Both `VALIDATION.md` files are regenerated accordingly: the Chain Governor message hash and the Chain Governor nonce state-change rows.

Only the Chain Governor message hashes change. The Foundation Upgrade Safe and Security Council message hashes cover `approveHash(<root safe tx hash>)` under their own (unchanged) nonces, and the Unichain 3-of-3 root safe tx hash is unaffected by a child safe's nonce — re-simulation confirms both are byte-identical.

| | 069 | 070 |
|---|---|---|
| Chain Governor message hash | `0x28e77c5d…f6197` → `0x3cbf706c1d884418b1747e65b9d5f4fc0cf22f4591ad9f47517b2df845259c85` | `0xe2d1b1a2…e6e6ed` → `0x3f3046779ff8be4fcb83c0e82311351d2cec5ae0d71877f9987629133748fdb6` |
| FUS / SC message hashes | unchanged | unchanged |

## Live nonces re-verified on mainnet

| Safe | Live | 067 | 068 | 069 | 070 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unichain 3-of-3 `0x6d5B…5833` | 10 | — | — | 10 | 11 |
| Unichain Chain Governor `0xb0c4…44EC` | **20** | — | — | **20** | **21** |
| FoundationUpgradeSafe `0x847B…9D92` | 66 | 66 | 67 | 68 | 69 |
| SecurityCouncil `0xc281…Bd03` | 65 | 65 | 66 | 67 | 68 |
| L1PAO `0x5a0A…3d2A` | 40 | 40 | 41 | — | — |

Tasks 067 and 068 needed no changes — their pins still line up with the live values. Task 066 is `[CANCELLED]` and 065 is `[EXECUTED]`, so neither is in the stack.

## Verification

`just simulate-stack eth` — the exact CI command — now passes end to end (exit 0) against a mainnet fork, simulating 067 → 068 → 069 → 070 across all child-safe paths. No `StateOverrideManager` or `TaskManager` hash-mismatch failures remain.

> [!NOTE]
> Nonce pins are live-state-dependent. Signers should still re-verify with `cast call <safe> "nonce()(uint256)" --rpc-url mainnet` immediately before signing, per the `CAUTION` block in each `VALIDATION.md`.
